headline: DeepSeek's provider share jumps to 29.9% as Qwen's 35B sprints to an all-time record
summary: The provider scoreboard had the day's biggest swing: DeepSeek now holds 29.9% of tokens, up 3.1 points. Meanwhile Qwen's qwen3.6-35b-a3b vaulted 11 places to #15 and set an all-time token-share record at 1.7%.
highlights: DeepSeek's provider share is 29.9% today, up 3.1 points on the day, the biggest provider-level move in the data.
Qwen's qwen3.6-35b-a3b jumped 11 places to #15 and set an all-time token-share record at 1.7%.
StepFun's step-5-preview fell 18 spots to #24 and lost 4.6 points of share in a single day. Ouch.
DeepSeek and Zhipu AI together hold 42.5% of tokens, the top two providers in a combined share.
NVIDIA's nemotron-3.5-super-vl debuted at #18 with 1.3%, and OpenAI's gpt-6-luna-pro (#47) and gpt-6-astra (#49) made their first appearance.
Anthropic's claude-fable-5.1, Google's gemini-2.5-flash and gemma-4-26b-a4b-it all dropped off the board.
